name: Shriram Finance Ltd
title: Shriram Finance Ltd - 511218 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Shriram Finance Q4 FY26 AUM up 14.85% YoY to INR3.02 lakh cr with NIM 8.61% and PAT up 40.9%, but gross Stage 3 edged up to 4.58% and FY27 AUM growth budgeted at 18% is not yet reconfirmed beyond Q1.

triggers.label: Gross Stage 3 4.55% → 4.58% YoY
triggers.quote: gross Stage 3, 4.55 to 4.58 only 3 basis points year-on-year

triggers.label: FY27 AUM growth 18% budgeted
triggers.quote: We have projected and budgeted 18%, and we'll grow at 18%.

triggers.label: Cost of liabilities 8.96% → 8.59%
triggers.quote: The cost of liabilities have marginally come down compared to previous quarter from 8.69% to 8.59%.

guidance.quote: We have projected and budgeted 18%, and we'll grow at 18%.
it should be around between 26% to 27%
Interest margin, we have budgeted 8.5 only.
We'll be looking at around 13% to 15% growth.
You will be able to see more than 20% growth in passenger vehicle.

prior_guidance_check.quote: we are closing this year at 15%

red_flags.label: Stage 2+3 rising in CV/PV/MSME
red_flags.quote: Within PV, we have seen highest GS2 increase.

red_flags.label: Credit cost review deferred to Q1
red_flags.quote: we will be revisiting the number after the first quarter result
